name: Craven Rat
body:
You are a sneaky, and dangerous coward.

Prerequisite(s): Sneak attack, cannot be immune to fear or mind-affecting effects.

Benefit(s): You take a -2 penalty on saving throws against fear effects but you deal 1 extra damage per character level when dealing sneak attack damage. This extra damage is considered precision damage and is not multiplied on a critical hit. If you become immune to fear or mind affecting due to spells, abilities or magic items, you lose the penalty and benefit of this feat.
